# `ecommerce_product_category_valid`

> Every product belongs to a known category, so category reports add up to the total.

| | |
|---|---|
| Domain | [ecommerce](README.md) |
| Layer | **silver** — evaluated by the `silver` gate |
| Model | `slv_ecommerce__products` (`ecommerce_silver.slv_ecommerce__products`) |
| Column | `category` |
| Check | `accepted_values` |
| Severity | `error` — a violation **stops the pipeline** |
| Defined in | [dbt/models/ecommerce/silver/_silver.yml](../../../dbt/models/ecommerce/silver/_silver.yml) |

## What it checks

`category` is one of: `electronics`, `books`, `home`, `fashion`, `toys`.

## When it fails

The `silver` task of `medallion_ecommerce` fails, gold and `publish_gold` don't run, and the batch is never added to `ecommerce_gold`: consumers keep the batches published before. `quality_report` marks the run as blocked and sends the alert, if one is configured.

The rows that broke the rule in its latest evaluation are kept in `dq_audit.ecommerce_product_category_valid`.

## Tested by

No sample-data scenario trips this rule yet: it guards against cases the generators don't produce.
